figures.title: 今日图表（彭博 Aug 18）— 长期美债收益率升至近二十年最高
figures.analysis: 彭博「今日图表」标题：长期美国国债收益率升至近二十年最高水平；副题：近年来美国借贷成本飙升。橙线为30年期美国国债收益率，纵轴约0–6%，横轴约2007年至2026年。2020年附近见低于1%的低点后，2022年起陡升，右端回到金融危机前高位附近。来源标注彭博。So what：这是长端收益率的长历史线，不是当日Treasury曲线收盘；与NBS内需放缓和伊朗停火CLAIMS并行阅读，长端供给/通胀风险把30Y钉在高位。

themeCards.title: 30Y at a two-decade high is the US rates / equity / USD test
themeCards.fact: AP: S&P 7,745.06 (−0.5%) as oil rose. Inbox chart: 30Y near a 20-year high. Inbox 市场一览: 长期国债领跌; 彭博美元指数触及三个月新低 (CLAIM — desk). Official curve prints live in Market closes.
themeCards.mechanism: Soft US retail last week bid pause-odds (equities near record, dollar desk-soft). The same tape left the long end lead — duration pain for USTs and a ceiling on how far USD can fade. Import prices tonight split those two books.
themeCards.trigger: Hot July import prices or hawkish minutes Aug 19.
themeCards.invalidator: Soft pipeline that fades hike odds without a 30Y extension.

themeCards.title: China July demand miss is an A-share, CNY, and China-rates story
themeCards.fact: NBS: July IP +4.5% y/y (miss vs +4.8%); retail +0.6% (miss vs 1.5%); Jan–Jul FAI −6.7% (miss vs −6.2%); jobless 5.2%. 财新: IP also +0.11% m/m. Inbox: 金龙中国指数连续第二天上涨 (CLAIM — desk, not a cash close).
themeCards.mechanism: Retail/FAI are the weak leg — that is the A-share domestic beta and the reason not to read overnight OMO as easing. CNY stays a second-order book unless SAFE 售汇 (CLAIM) gets a second source. CICC CLAIM (Jul 15): 内需仍待刺激 — prior-month claim, not a new July note.
themeCards.trigger: August NBS that re-accelerates retail/FAI, or a credit rebound that shows up in FAI.
themeCards.invalidator: August prints that reverse the 0.6/−6.7 miss.

themeCards.title: Oil is Iran-CLAIM beta — not a Hormuz flow print
themeCards.fact: Inbox: Trump refused to extend the US-Iran temporary ceasefire and restated Hormuz-as-US-territory talk (CLAIM). AP: oil rose Monday as that tape hit. Inbox 能源: 油价攀升 (desk).
themeCards.mechanism: Isolation/ceasefire CLAIM is not a Hormuz closure. It is an oil-beta headline and a risk-off USD/JPY twitch until a dated flow shock. Pair with the Brent row in Market closes; do not promote desk “攀升” to a settle.
themeCards.trigger: Confirmed strike on flows or a dated ceasefire extension.
themeCards.invalidator: Quiet oil with no flow disruption.

themeCards.title: Overnight OMO is China-rates plumbing, not a demand offset
themeCards.fact: 第一财经: PBOC overnight reverse-repo Aug 14 and Aug 17–19, daily cap 6,000亿元 (CNY600bn). Today is still inside that window.
themeCards.mechanism: Give-quantity cash, not a rate signal. It does not restart retail/FAI and should not be stacked on the NBS miss as “easing.” Watch allotment vs the cap into Aug 19; CNY is a side book.
themeCards.trigger: Allotment at the cap plus another weak activity print.
themeCards.invalidator: Tiny overnight prints and a firm August rebound.
